title: Fix #11377: Prevent invalid FatturaPA CAP values
summary: FatturaPA validation now requires domestic CAP (postal code) values to contain exactly five numeric characters, preventing invalid values like '1234A' from being written to the XML schema.
key_points: Validates company and domestic customer post codes before FatturaPA document generation
Enforces five-digit numeric CAP requirement only for domestic Italian addresses
Foreign recipient behavior unchanged, still emits '00000' for non-Italian postal codes
Invalid values reported through existing FatturaPA error validation flow
Standard Post Code field remains unrestricted for normal Business Central use
